Cheap S-class fix. Lane note: devx@objectstack seat currently vacant.

## ACCEPT — PR #12759, reviewed against the diff rather than the report

Reviewer of record: devx lane PM, session `session_01PfaSTikked61BkcsB5Rn69`, round 13.

| criterion | reading |
|---|---|
| PR shape | draft ✓ · base `main` ✓ · first line `Fixes #12472` ✓ |
| scope | 1 file, **+37/−1**, `scripts/check-cli-command-ids.mjs` — exactly the declared surface, nothing widened |
| governed surface | `scripts/` is **not** governed — and the repo's own **Governed Surface Guard** check ran **green** on this head, so that is measured, not assumed. ⇒ lands via the merge queue, ⛔ not pushed to the maintainer |
| changeset | `skip-changeset` correct — root `scripts/` publishes nothing |
| CI | 6 checks green (Governed Surface Guard, Single-Claim Path Guard, Part-of Closing-Keyword Guard, Duplicate Fix Guard, Check Links, PR Automation); **CI** and **Lint & Type Check** still running at review time. ⇒ ACCEPT recorded now, **landing gated on green** — see below |

### Spot-checks I ran on the diff myself

- **The declaration stays a literal.** It is not in the diff at all, so it is unchanged — Zone 1's ⛔ is satisfied structurally rather than by promise.
- **The scope really is the declaration statement.** `/\bconst\s+ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS\s*=\s*([^;]*);/g`, and the assertion tests `declSites[0][1]` — the RHS — not the file.
- **The needle is derived, not spelled**: `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS.every((h) => …includes(\`'${h}'\`) || …includes(\`"${h}"\`))`, so it grows with the declaration and covers both quote styles.
- ⭐ **Two vacuity guards, and both are load-bearing.** `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS.length > 0` stops `.every()` passing on an empty array, and the companion case pins the declaration statement to **exactly one** site so the pin can never silently judge nothing. That companion case is also what protects the new regex from a future comment growing a second `const ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS =` spelling — it would go loud rather than pick the wrong site.

### ⭐ The dev corrected me, and I am recording it plainly

**My Zone 3 suggestion was wrong, and it was falsified by measurement rather than argued with.** I pointed at the assembled-needle remedy that landed in `scripts/check-objectql-double-limit.mjs`. The dev applied exactly that on disk, together with the computed declaration, and got:

```
assembled needle present : 1
inline needle gone       : 0
computed decl present    : 1
remaining literal spelling: 545:  ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS.includes('scripts/**')
check-cli-command-ids self-test: 38 cases pass    SELFTEST_EXIT=0
```

Still could not fail. The sibling spells its hint **twice** (declaration, assertion) so un-spelling the assertion leaves the declaration as the only copy; this file spells it a **third** time in the runtime-value case below, and a whole-file `includes` finds that copy. ⇒ **scope is the fix; the derived needle is only hygiene.** A precedent tells you how to think, not how to edit — this is that rule earning its place, and the PR body records the counter-measurement so the next reader inherits it.

⭐ Also right, and not asked for: the dev **refused** to import `extractWatchHints` to pin the real contract, because `dispatch-gates.mjs` documents that a gate importing it inherits its module-body literals as watch hints — measured there at 2660 files covered of which **2632 are fabricated**. Declining a tempting stronger pin because it would fabricate coverage is the correct call.

### Zone 2 confirmed

My assumption that `:544` does not close the gap **held**: it asserts the array's runtime value, which the computed form satisfies, and it stayed green throughout.

### Out-of-scope finding — verified present and well-formed

**#12762** — 11 of the 13 gates declaring `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS` carry no literal-spelling pin at all. Unassigned, `finding` + `tooling` + `domain:devx`, no `pm:queue`. ⭐ It states plainly what it did **not** measure — whether `bare-root-worklist --self-test` / `check:pm-dispatch-gates` already catch this from the other side — and names that check as step one, with closing the card as the right outcome if they do. That is the honest shape for a class observation; ⛔ it must not be dispatched as a build before that check is run.

⚠️ Cross-read against this round's sibling report (#12634 → #12760): the two findings are **not** twins — different gates, different mechanisms. No consolidation needed.

### Landing

`check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`'s first `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` was correctly recorded as **not measured** rather than as either colour, then re-run green after `pnpm install`. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is a **declared narrowing**, not a silent skip — CI runs the farm regardless.

⛔ Not flipping ready yet: **every check on the PR must be green, not just the required subset** — a non-required red is either a real defect or a broken gate, and both are mine to handle before the queue. Will flip to ready and enqueue once CI and Lint & Type Check land green.
